lead: Calm cinematic sci-fi film still, dusky plum space, warm sand gold and rose glow.
notes: Mood-only mini images for antigrav_deconstruction.html, beside the lore, game layer and feature text. SDXL (free): gen antigrav_deconstruction-mini --model sdxl --max 999, then finish antigrav_deconstruction-mini --model sdxl. Each prompt is the section's opening line; the images add flavor and never try to show a mechanic accurately.
